videos.headline: Lac-Mégantic, the channel's first Short with watch data: 450 views, and 43% stayed to watch.

why.text: 450 views so far; 10.7% came from search ('lac megantic train derailment'), more than the 2–3% the other channels get.
57.5% viewed, 43% stayed to watch and 23.2% held after the hook; no other Short has data yet to compare with.
The first fall, 15.6 points, came at 1.5 s during the hook line 'A train with no one aboard reached Lac-Mégantic. How?'; another 12.5 points left at 5.4 s on 'It was doing 65 miles an hour'.

videos.next: Put the runaway train moving on screen in the first second, before the question is spoken.

videos.headline: The Mississippi tanker drew 1,166 views in 48 hours, over twice the median.

why.text: 1,166 views in 48 hours against the Shorts median of 471.
59.2% viewed against the median of 63.9%; 54.8% stayed to watch against 51.6%.
17.5 points left at 5.3 s on "Its rudder had stuck to starboard. From then, it had 2 minutes."
Only 18.2% held after the hook to the end, the lowest of the channel's three Shorts.

videos.next: Keep the countdown, but show the stuck rudder on screen when it is said; the second beat lost the most.

videos.headline: Kobe Bryant's helicopter sits on the channel median: 471 views, 63.9% viewed.

why.text: 471 views in 48 hours, the Shorts median.
63.9% viewed, on the median; 51.6% stayed to watch.
15.9 points left at 5.2 s on the climb numbers line (1,500 feet a minute, 2,400 feet).
8.7% of views came from search, more than the other Shorts.

videos.next: Two altitude numbers in the second beat lost viewers; show one number on a thing in the place and say the rest later.

videos.headline: The Hyatt walkway long video has 9 views in 48 hours and 0.8% CTR.

why.text: 9 views in 48 hours against the long median of 12.
CTR 0.79%: few people who saw the thumbnail clicked.

videos.next: Test a thumbnail that shows the collapsed walkway itself; the click, not the watch, is the first problem.

videos.headline: BP Texas City has 15 views, nearly all from related videos.

why.text: 15 views against the long median of 12.
37.4% viewed against 33%, but only 20% stayed to watch.
14 of 15 views (93.3%) came from related videos.

videos.next: Too few views to judge the script; the related-video traffic says a promo Short pointing to it is the way to reach more people.
